# MDL403 · `invalid-number`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A numeric option's value is not a number GLib accepts.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | options |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | G5, G7 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl403-invalid-octal-threads-fatal`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl403-invalid-octal-threads-fatal.txtar) |

## Why

GLib parses integer options with C's `strtol` in base 0 and rejects anything left over: `08` (a leading 0 means octal, where 8 and 9 are not digits), `1e3`, `10k`, `4.5`. A value too large for the option is out of range. Either way mydumper aborts at startup with `option parsing failed`.

Trailing spaces are reported by MDL302, empty values by MDL404.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=08
chunk-filesize=1e3
statement-size=10k
long-query-guard=99999999999
```

```text
2:9-2:11 error MDL403[invalid-number] `08` is not a valid value for `threads`: a leading 0 makes the number octal, where 8 and 9 are not digits (GLib: Cannot parse integer value “08” for --threads)
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Cannot parse integer value “08” for --threads, try --help".
3:16-3:19 error MDL403[invalid-number] `1e3` is not a valid value for `chunk-filesize`: exponents are not accepted (GLib: Cannot parse integer value “1e3” for --chunk-filesize)
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Cannot parse integer value “1e3” for --chunk-filesize, try --help".
4:16-4:19 error MDL403[invalid-number] `10k` is not a valid value for `statement-size`: unit suffixes are not accepted: write the plain number (GLib: Cannot parse integer value “10k” for --statement-size)
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Cannot parse integer value “10k” for --statement-size, try --help".
5:18-5:29 error MDL403[invalid-number] `99999999999` is not a valid value for `long-query-guard`: too large for the option (GLib: Integer value “99999999999” for --long-query-guard out of range)
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Integer value “99999999999” for --long-query-guard out of range, try --help".
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL403: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL403` on the line above it.
